scenario_summary: 1,200-employee precision parts manufacturer licenses Veridian's cloud ERP for 24 months. Bundle includes the SaaS license, a go-live implementation project (completed end of month 2), and day-1 on-site training — three distinct POBs requiring SSP-based allocation of the $200k bundled price.

performance_obligations.name: ERP SaaS License
performance_obligations.description: 24-month access to Veridian cloud ERP (production planning, inventory, finance, HR modules) for up to 150 named users. Customer continuously receives benefit as Veridian operates and updates the platform.

ssp.basis: $6,000/month observable from standalone ERP license renewals at comparable customer size

performance_obligations.name: Go-Live Implementation
performance_obligations.description: Data migration, system configuration, integrations with Hartwell's MES and warehouse systems, and user-acceptance testing. Veridian project team works on-site and remotely over ~8 weeks. Distinct from the license — Hartwell could contract any certified Veridian partner for implementation.

ssp.basis: Adjusted market assessment: comparable ERP implementation projects for similar-size manufacturers range $30k–$45k; midpoint $36k used

performance_obligations.name: On-Site End-User Training
performance_obligations.description: 3-day intensive training for 40 key users (floor managers, finance team, IT) delivered at Hartwell's Riverside facility on contract start. Training materials and recordings transferred to customer. Distinct — benefit fully consumed on delivery.

ssp.basis: 3 trainers × 3 days × $1,800/day blended rate + 25% margin + travel = ~$20,000
